articles.title: Sylvester Stallone, 80, reveals why he did not go to his mother's funeral: “Some people should not have children”
articles.standfirst: At 80 years old, the star of Rocky decided to share unknown details of his childhood, his complicated relationship with his parents, the death of his son Sage, and the decisions that shaped his life in and out of Hollywood.
articles.summary: At 80 years old, the star of Rocky decided to share unknown details of his childhood, his complicated relationship with his parents, the death of his son Sage, and the decisions that shaped his life in and out of Hollywood.
articles.body:
S ylvester Stallone decided to look back and tell some of the most difficult chapters of his life. At 80 years old and with the publication of The Steps, his new memoir, the Rocky star speaks of a complicated childhood, the wounds he carried for decades, and a family relationship that was far from the image he would later project in Hollywood.

One of the most striking revelations has to do with his mother, Jackie Stallone . The actor said he was playing golf when he received the news of her death in 2020 and acknowledged that he did not attend her funeral . Behind that decision was a relationship marked for decades by an enormous emotional distance.

The difficult relationship Sylvester Stallone had with his mother

Stallone has spoken bluntly about the lack of affection he felt during his childhood. Remembering Jackie, a woman also known for her eccentric personality and her work related to astrology, he stated that he never received from her the affection he expected from a mother.

“I was playing golf when someone called me and said to me, ‘Your mother has died’”

Reflecting on his past, he said: “She never hugged me.” Stallone grew up with the feeling that his mother simply was not prepared to take on that role, while his relationship with his father, Frank Stallone Sr ., was also marked by distance and difficult episodes.

That childhood, as he now explains, ended up influencing the way he faced much of his adult life. For years he built a personality based on enduring, competing, and proving that he could withstand anything, a kind of armor that he also transferred to characters such as Rocky Balboa .

Success finally came after years of hardship and rejection in New York. Rocky, written by and starring Stallone, transformed his career and made him one of the most recognizable figures in cinema, but it did not necessarily resolve the conflicts he had been carrying long before achieving fame.

The death of his son Sage, another wound that Stallone carries

Decades later, Stallone had to face a completely different loss. His eldest son, Sage Stallone, died in 2012 at the age of 36 from heart disease. The actor has acknowledged that that death continues to be one of the most painful episodes of his life.

The loss also forced him to look at his own experience as a father. Stallone admits that for much of his career he was focused almost exclusively on making his way and staying in Hollywood, something he began to view from a different perspective over the years.

His story will make it to the big screen with I Play Rocky

Stallone's memoir is also arriving at a particularly symbolic moment in his career. Fifty years after the release of Rocky , his story behind that film will be brought to the big screen in I Play Rocky , the biopic directed by Peter Farrelly that will arrive in theaters on November 6, 2026.

The film stars Anthony Ippolito , who plays a young Stallone during the years when he was trying to make his way in Hollywood and refused to part with the Rocky script unless the producers agreed to let him play Rocky Balboa himself. Stallone was not directly involved in the production and acknowledged that he initially had mixed feelings about the idea of his life making it to the big screen while he was still able to tell it.

“I’m not dead yet” , Stallone joked when speaking about the project in an interview with CBS Sunday Morning. However, his reaction changed after seeing Ippolito’s work and noticing the actor’s resemblance to his younger self. The film already had its premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival before its commercial release

Stallone continues working and starring in Tulsa King , but he says that his relationship with time has changed: after decades trying to prove that he could withstand any blow , he now seems more willing to talk about those he never managed to leave completely behind.

articles.title: Diddy is planning a move outside of prison once conditions behind bars come to an end
articles.standfirst: Sean Combs will be getting out of prison much earlier than first anticipated.
articles.summary: Sean Combs will be getting out of prison much earlier than first anticipated.
articles.body:
Once again, Sean Combs ' release date from prison has been moved up. Diddy is now scheduled to be released on January 21, 2028 , according to Federal Bureau of Prisons record (per TMZ ). It's a far cry from the life sentence some believed he might get, when the legal process began.

With the new date in mind, it sounds like Diddy is already setting up plans for his life after prison . The information comes from Cheyenne Roundtree , a senior reporter at Rolling Stone who just recently released a book about Diddy titled " Bad Boy for Life: The Rise and Fall of Sean Combs ".

Diddy will likely release a documentary giving his side of the story once he's out of prison

Roundtree believes that Combs is already thinking of a way to shape the narrative around him , even while he's still behind bars. But once he's out, he's going to give his side of the story in regards to all of the damning claims and evidence levied against him.

He is planning a doc of his own and his own comeback story... I have no doubt that eventually, whenever he is released, that he will come forward and he will say everything he has to say over these past few years.

There have already been several documentaries made about Diddy's escapades and what led to his arrest. His entire life has been explored, but never through his own eyes.

Given everything that has come out about his past, everyone will be hard-pressed to believe what he says in a documentary of his own.

articles.title: Kim Kardashian faces a $80,000 dilemma after doing something that felt "illegal"
articles.standfirst: Kim Kardashian knew exactly what she was doing when she put her signature on a luxury Birkin
articles.summary: Kim Kardashian knew exactly what she was doing when she put her signature on a luxury Birkin
articles.body:
K im Kardashian is a loyal follower of luxury fashion and knows the value of these pieces , but she may now go down in fashion history for doing something that felt almost illegal to her. At a Skims event in Shanghai on Monday night, Kardashian was handed a metallic gold pen and asked to sign her name in the middle of a fan's red crocodile Hermès Birkin 35, apparently.

The reality star appeared hesitant before taking the pen, aware of what the signature could mean for such an expensive handbag. She joked about the situation feeling illegal and even described it as blasphemous before eventually deciding to go through with it.

A signature on a very expensive handbag

Despite her hesitation, Kardashian did sign the bag, leaving her autograph on what appears to be a highly valuable Hermès piece. A viral video shows the moment as the fan hands her the Birkin and Kardashian pauses before putting her name on it with the gold marker.

The moment has drawn attention because the original social media post claimed the bag was worth around $80,000. Kardashian is also known for her appreciation of Hermès, making her hesitation understandable given how closely a Birkin's condition is tied to its value.

Kim Kardashian's most expensive autograph?

Now, Kim Kardashian's most expensive autograph may live on a Birkin bag. A handbag of this kind can be significantly affected by its condition, materials and history, making any permanent mark a major decision for its owner.

articles.title: “I’m just angry”: Andrew Garfield reveals what his first day filming with Robert Redford was really like
articles.standfirst: Andrew Garfield was just 23 years old and about to share the set with Meryl Streep and Robert Redford in his first movie.
articles.summary: Andrew Garfield was just 23 years old and about to share the set with Meryl Streep and Robert Redford in his first movie.
articles.body:
Recently, Andrew Garfield shared the story behind one of the most unexpected experiences he had while filming a movie many people have probably seen. Lions for Lambs brought together a major cast that included Meryl Streep and Robert Redford , but while the finished film looked polished on screen, Garfield’s first encounter with Redford was anything but.

Garfield arrived ready. Redford made him wait four hours

Garfield arrived early and completely prepared for one of those moments that, for an actor, can feel almost unreal.

But then, Redford took four hours to arrive .

For Garfield, the wait completely changed the excitement he had brought with him to set. At first, he was “terrified and nervous and pinching myself,” still trying to process that he was about to work for the first time with stars like Redford and Meryl Streep. Four hours later, those nerves were gone and had been replaced by something much simpler: “I’m just angry.”

So, how did Robert Redford finally show up?

When he finally arrived, Redford didn't seem nearly as concerned about the clock as Garfield had been . The actor remembered him as relaxed, casual and completely in his own world, which also fit with his reputation for being late.

Garfield even joked about Redford’s clothes, saying he still had the style of someone in his 20s , including the denim-on-denim look. But, ironically, those four hours ended up working in the young actor’s favor: by the time they started working, he was no longer frozen by nerves.

What Redford did next surprised Garfield

The real impression came once they started working. After filming his own coverage, Redford would ask Garfield what he thought and whether he wanted to do another take .

For someone making his first movie, having a figure like Redford ask for his opinion was unexpected. Garfield didn't feel like the newcomer who was simply there to follow instructions . Redford was giving him room to be part of the creative process.

articles.standfirst: Oscar winner Anne Hathaway surprised everyone by revealing how the Inter Miami captain ended up saving an everyday situation with her little ones in the United States
articles.summary: Oscar winner Anne Hathaway surprised everyone by revealing how the Inter Miami captain ended up saving an everyday situation with her little ones in the United States
articles.body:
The figure of Lionel Messi transcends borders, sports disciplines, and social classes across the globe. The Inter Miami icon became a universal symbol of admiration that connects millions of people regardless of their nationality or language.

In recent hours, a prominent figure in international cinema once again highlighted the cultural reach of the footballer from Rosario . As part of the promotional tour for the highly anticipated film Verity, a renowned American actress shared an emotional family experience linked to the world soccer star.

The confession came during an interview given to the news channel TN on the occasion of the upcoming film release , where the actress shared the panel with her castmates Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett .

The magical gesture with her son

Anne Hathaway , 43, recalled a recent encounter between one of her sons —Jonathan, 10, and Jake, 6, from her relationship with producer Adam Shulman— and another child in the United States. According to the star of The Devil Wears Prada , both children were paralyzed by their initial shyness and could not find a way to strike up a conversation .

Faced with the awkward silence, the actress decided to step in actively to break the ice and asked the other boy if he liked Lionel Messi . The little boy’s immediate positive response prompted her son’s enthusiastic reaction, creating an instant connection that turned them into friends in a matter of seconds .

"It is a bridge to so many wonderful things" , the Hollywood actress said emotionally as she described the fascinating influence generated by the Argentine number ten on today's childhood.

Argentine ambassadors around the world

Likewise, Hathaway highlighted the role of Argentine athletes and personalities by pointing out that the South American country has "incredible ambassadors" in global popular culture . During the talk covered by outlets such as Infobae, Página/12 and Diario Huarpe, the artist recalled her fondness for the southern nation after having previously crossed paths with actor Joaquín Furriel at a European fashion event .

This is not the first time the actress has shown her fascination with the Rosario star’s circle, as some time ago she was photographed posing in official Inter Miami gear alongside David Beckham himself at Yankee Stadium.

For her part, her co-star Dakota Johnson also took advantage of the interview to praise Argentina , declaring her fascination with the city of Buenos Aires, the local gastronomy, and the warmth of its people after having visited it on several occasions.

Hollywood at the feet of the Flea

The touching anecdote told by the actress adds to a growing list of major celebrities from the film industry who publicly profess their admiration for the Argentine captain . Figures such as Matt Damon, who described the Rosario-born forward as the greatest athlete in history, or Mark Wahlberg, have frequently praised the talent and leadership of the global icon.

As highlighted by Mundo Deportivo, the star's influence transcends the ball to become a sociocultural phenomenon with global reach .

In this way, Lionel Messi's legacy continues writing unexpected chapters far beyond the stadiums , establishing itself as a true meeting point of contemporary pop culture.

articles.title: Clint Eastwood, actor: "I don't believe in pessimism. If something doesn't come up the way you want, forge ahead"
articles.standfirst: Eastwood’s move from actor to director reflected the same mindset
articles.summary: Eastwood’s move from actor to director reflected the same mindset
articles.body:
Clint Eastwood has never built his movie career around the idea that every decision will work. His outlook has been much simpler, and to keep moving.

“I don't believe in pessimism. If something doesn't come up the way you want, forge ahead,” Eastwood once said, a line that neatly captures the philosophy that has followed him through decades as an actor, director and producer.

That attitude matters because Eastwood ’s career has never been a straight line. He moved from television westerns into major movie roles, then gradually shifted behind the camera at a time when many stars would have been content to remain in front of it.

The decision to direct gave Eastwood another route forward and allowed him to reshape his career rather than wait for Hollywood to decide what came next.

Eastwood built longevity by refusing to stand still

Eastwood began directing in the 1970s and eventually became known as much for his work behind the camera as for his performances.

That transition reflected the same instinct. When one phase of a career changes, the answer isn't necessarily to cling to what worked before, but to find the next challenge and continue.

Eastwood has also spoken about trusting his instincts rather than becoming trapped by second-guessing. His filmmaking style has long favored efficiency, decisiveness and momentum, with an emphasis on making progress rather than endlessly searching for perfection.

He once joked that he seemed to have a habit of making “pictures nobody wants to do,” a comment that reflected his willingness to pursue material that did not always fit conventional expectations.

That independence helped define his reputation. Some projects worked better than others, but Eastwood rarely allowed one disappointment to become a reason to stop taking risks.

Why the quote still feels relevant

The strength of Eastwood ’s advice is that it doesn't pretend failure can be avoided. He accepts that plans go wrong, projects disappoint and careers change direction. The important part, in his view, is what happens after that moment.

His own career offers repeated examples of adaptation. He evolved from television actor to movie star, from star to filmmaker, and from mainstream action projects to quieter dramas without allowing any single version of himself to become permanent.

Eastwood ’s message isn't that optimism guarantees success. It's that pessimism can become its own obstacle if it prevents someone from taking the next step. His career has lasted because he kept looking for that next step.

The movies changed, the industry changed and expectations changed around him, but the principle remained the same, that if the outcome isn't what you wanted, keep going anyway.

articles.title: Savannah James tightens the reins on spending her own money outside her life with LeBron James
articles.standfirst: LeBron James' wife and April McDaniell have been friends for more than 15 years, co-host a podcast together, and share business ventures, but they have a curious rule when they travel together. Find out about it here.
articles.summary: LeBron James' wife and April McDaniell have been friends for more than 15 years, co-host a podcast together, and share business ventures, but they have a curious rule when they travel together. Find out about it here.
articles.body:
Savannah James , LeBron James' wife, once again found herself at the center of a conversation on social media after her best friend and business partner, April McDaniel , explained how they handle the financial difference between them: when they travel together, they do not necessarily fly in the same class on the plane .

The topic came up during an appearance by both of them on Mental Wealth. There they talked about money, business, and a friendship of more than 15 years that also ended up becoming a business partnership. It was McDaniel who put on the table a reality that both of them know perfectly well. “We talk a lot about this because there are two different lifestyles. articles.title: Julie Andrews, 90-year-old actress: "Perseverance is failing 19 times and succeeding the 20th"
articles.standfirst: The legendary actress' words carry weight after a career that required triumph and reinvention
articles.summary: The legendary actress' words carry weight after a career that required triumph and reinvention
articles.body:
J ulie Andrews ' career is filled with the kind of achievements that can make success look effortless as from the stage of Mary Poppins and The Sound of Music , she became one of the most recognizable performers of her generation. ​ ​The quote most closely associated with her view of resilience focuses not on success itself, however, but on the repeated failures that often come before it.

"Perseverance is failing 19 times and succeeding the 20th," Andrews once said, and the message is deliberately simple: Failure is not valuable because it feels good or because every setback automatically leads somewhere better. It matters because continuing after disappointment is often what separates a temporary defeat from a lasting one. ​ ​That distinction is why the quote has remained relevant across careers, education, creative work and personal goals - and the lesson became more profound later in Andrews ' own career.

Andrews' own life gave the words additional meaning

After developing an exceptional singing voice as a child and building a celebrated musical career around it, she then faced one of her most devastating setbacks in the late 1990s. ​ ​Surgery on her vocal cords severely affected her ability to sing and a career built partly on one of the most famous voices in entertainment was quickly threatened with ending. ​ ​But Andrews responded emphatically as she found other ways to work, expanding her range to include written works along with continuing to act on the screen and in voice roles. ​ ​Demonstrating that perseverance is not always about recovering exactly what had been lost, sometimes it means building something different to what came before - and this is what makes the "19 times" element so important. ​ ​The number is less a literal formula than a way of describing the accumulated frustration that comes from rejection, mistakes and repeated attempts that appear to go nowhere. ​ ​Success from the 20th attempt only matters because the first 19 did not end the effort, particularly poignant as modern society often compresses success into the moment that somebody finally breaks through. ​ ​The failed auditions, abandoned ideas and rejected applications usually receive far less attention, and Andrews ' quote aims to cut through that tendency but putting the unsuccessful attempts at the center of the story. It also avoids pretending that perseverance guarantees a perfect outcome: People can work hard and still fall short. Circumstances change, opportunities can slip away and some goals have to be reconsidered.​ But the point is that failure itself does not have to make that decision and at 90, Andrews ' career offers a perfect example of that principle in action.​

articles.title: Fiona Lowe's cause of death: Rob Lowe's nice dies at just 13 years old
articles.standfirst: Fiona's family has encouraged people to reach out to the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
articles.summary: Fiona's family has encouraged people to reach out to the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
articles.body:
Chad Lowe and his family are mourning the death of his 13-year-old daughter, Fiona , with the teenager remembered as a girl who loved to dance.

The 58-year-old Chad shared Fiona with his wife, Kim Painter , and the couple also have two more daughters named Mabel and Nixie , who are now grieving as the family confirmed the death of their middle child.

"We are deeply heartbroken by the loss of our beloved Fiona," the Lowe family said to Page Six. "She was a loving young girl who was smart, creative and loved to dance. She was adored by her sisters, and she was deeply loved by her parents.

"In fact, she was the light of our lives. Her passing is devastating for our entire family, and we ask for prayers and privacy at this time. If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health, please reach out to the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline by calling or texting 988."

The family's reference to mental health support has prompted attention to the broader challenge facing young people, but it does not establish Fiona 's cause of death as suicide.

Lowe and Painter have been married since August 2010 and Chad is the younger brother of Rob , who was previously married to Hilary Swank before their divorce in 2006.

The family have asked for privacy in the wake of Fiona 's death as they cope with an unimaginable loss, and no cause has been publicly announced.

United States faces teenage mental health epidemic

Fiona 's death comes amid continued concerns about mental health and suicide among young people in the United States as CDC data shows that suicide was the second-leading cause of death among Americans aged 10-44 in 2024.

The CDC 's Youth Risk Behavior Survey found that 39.7% of high school students reported persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness, whilst 20.4% said they had seriously considered attempting suicide. 9.5% reported attempting suicide.

The same data showed significant differences among groups, with female students reporting higher rates of persistent sadness, suicidal thoughts, and attempts than male students.

LBGTQ+ students also reported substantially higher rates across several mental health and suicide-risk measures than heterosexual students.

The CDC has also identified supportive relationships with family, friends, schools and other trusted adults as protective factors.

Fortunately, its 2023 report showed some encouraging improvements from 2021, including declines of several measures of sadness, poor mental health and suicide risk.

articles.title: Diddy's ex-girlfriend sends him sexually explicit material while he's in prison, as she enjoys a life of luxury
articles.standfirst: Combs is serving a 50-month sentence for transportation to engage in prostitution, at FCI Fort Dix.
articles.summary: Combs is serving a 50-month sentence for transportation to engage in prostitution, at FCI Fort Dix.
articles.body:
S ean “Diddy” Combs is reportedly maintaining an unusually comfortable routine behind bars, with sources claiming the former music mogul has found ways to bring some of his old lifestyle into federal prison.

Combs is reportedly surrounded by other inmates who cook and clean for him, make his bed and do his laundry and one inmate has also allegedly given him Chinese-style massages.

The claims come as per NBC News, who say multiple sources who spent time in the same unit said Combs has other inmates performing various services for him. He is also reportedly using contraband cellphones to access Instagram and view sexually explicit material sent by an old girlfriend.

He is serving a 50-month sentence in New Jersey and sources who spent time in the same unit told NBC News that money from people outside prison is allegedly being routed to other inmates’ commissary accounts in exchange for services provided to Combs .

Other reported perks include access to a jailbroken tablet for watching movies and documentaries, while sources also claimed the music figure has paid for other inmates’ Remeron medication, which is prescribed for depression and anxiety.

The reports also allege that Combs has access to premium liquor on weekends and receives specially prepared meals. One former inmate described cooking for him before saying he eventually began using other inmates to prepare his food.

According to the sources, one inmate cleans the toilet and shower areas before Combs uses them, while others hold onto his phone and fan mail. The allegations describe a highly unusual prison routine for the convicted former music executive.

Why is Sean Combs in prison?

Combs was arrested in September 2024 and charged federally with racketeering, sex trafficking and transportation for prostitution. He was later tried in Manhattan , where the case drew extensive attention.

In July 2025, a jury found Combs guilty on two counts of transportation for purposes of prostitution involving his former girlfriends and male sex workers. He was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy and sex trafficking charges.

Combs was sentenced on Oct. 3, 2025, to 50 months in federal prison, followed by five years of supervised release. He is serving his sentence at Federal Correctional Institution Fort Dix. His sentence followed a highly publicized case that also included allegations from former girlfriend Cassie Ventura .

Ventura sued Combs in November 2023, alleging rape, sex trafficking and physical abuse, before the lawsuit was settled the following day. In May 2024, CNN released surveillance footage showing the adult male violent assaulting the smaller woman at a Los Angeles hotel in 2016.

Combs later apologized publicly, calling his actions in the footage inexcusable before the wider accusations of mass sexual abuse and coercive behavior emerged.

articles.title: Bruce Willis reappears alongside his daughter Tallulah, and a familiar gesture moves his followers once again
articles.standfirst: The 71-year-old actor appeared again in an image shared by his daughter, just a few weeks after having been present at her wedding. The photograph shows a moment of affection between the two and does not include any update on his health status.
articles.summary: The 71-year-old actor appeared again in an image shared by his daughter, just a few weeks after having been present at her wedding. The photograph shows a moment of affection between the two and does not include any update on his health status.
articles.body:
B ruce Willis was seen again in a photograph shared by his daughter Tallulah Willis . The image, published on September 28, shows the actor in an intimate family moment, far from the public exposure that marked much of his career.

In the photograph, Tallulah leans over Bruce, kisses him on the forehead, and holds his head in her hands. “So cute!” , she wrote alongside the post, one of the few recent images of the Die Hard star that his family has decided to share.

Tallulah's gesture that showed Bruce Willis again

The photograph arrives just a few weeks after another especially significant moment for the family: Tallulah's wedding to musician Justin Acee , held last August 8 in Sun Valley , Idaho. Bruce was present and appeared at the time in several photographs.

In one of those images, the Die Hard star appears alongside his daughter and Acee, with one arm around Tallulah while the musician holds one of her hands.

“Buuski”, as Tallulah presents herself on Instagram, is also the profile from which she usually opens a small window into her family life. There, she has now shared the photograph with her father, accompanied only by a brief “So cute!”, without making any reference to his health condition.

Tallulah, daughter of Bruce Willis and Demi Moore , has spoken on different occasions about how her interactions with her father have changed since his diagnosis of frontotemporal dementia. In 2024, she explained that her family tries to be with him regardless of what each day is like, and that she tries to focus on being present during her visits.

A life increasingly away from the spotlight

Bruce Willis retired from acting in 2022 after his family announced that he had initially been diagnosed with aphasia. In February 2023 , his relatives reported that the diagnosis had progressed to frontotemporal dementia .

Since then, his appearances have decreased considerably, and the main images and updates about his life have come through his wife, Emma Heming Willis , his daughters, and Demi Moore.

The importance of Tallulah's post lies precisely in the gesture: a simple photograph that once again shows the actor alongside one of his daughters and that comes shortly after the family accompanied him during another important moment in his life.

articles.title: Gandhi, pacifist: "Live as if you were going to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were going to live forever"'
articles.standfirst: This October 2 marks the International Day of Non-Violence, in commemoration of his birth in 1869.
articles.summary: This October 2 marks the International Day of Non-Violence, in commemoration of his birth in 1869.
articles.body:
Friday, October 2, is an important date as the International Day of Non-Violence is commemorated. The United Nations General Assembly chose this date in 2007 to honor Gandhi on the day of his birth. The pacifist has always been considered the foremost reference when it comes to the message of tolerance and peaceful resistance.

One of his quotes is among the most widely shared in history. “Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever,” Gandhi used to say. With this reflection, what he sought was to remind the entire population that we must enjoy the present without thinking about what the future has in store for us.

Gandhi promoted ‘carpe diem’ in most of his reflections

He was a firm believer that we should live as if the time of our life were very limited, so as to have an attitude of constant learning and growth. A day lost in our life is a mistake , since we must have urgency to live and patience to learn. This is the idea Gandhi sought to share with this quote.

It is not the only reflection that has crossed the barrier of time and is still constantly shared today. “Happiness appears when what you think, what you say, and what you do are in harmony,” “Behavior is the mirror that shows our image” or “Love is the most powerful force that exists,” are some of his other most important thoughts.

As a curiosity, it should be noted that Mahatma Gandhi never received the Nobel Peace Prize , despite having been nominated on five occasions (1937, 1938, 1939, 1947 and 1948). Years later, the committee responsible for awarding it described this situation as unfair. That said, in India the renowned Gandhi Peace Prize was created.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney revives Pamela Anderson's explosive look that defined an era on ‘Baywatch’
articles.standfirst: The actress turned heads in a red swimsuit. The choice inevitably recalled C.J. Parker, the character that made Pamela Anderson one of the great television icons of the 1990s.
articles.summary: The actress turned heads in a red swimsuit. The choice inevitably recalled C.J. Parker, the character that made Pamela Anderson one of the great television icons of the 1990s.
articles.body:
The actress surprised with a red swimsuit during her vacation in Utah. The one-piece design, with a plunging neckline, recalled the looks that Pamela Anderson popularized as C.J. Parker in ‘Baywatch ’ during the 1990s.

Sydney Sweeney shared several photos on Instagram from her vacation in Lake Powell, Utah, with her boyfriend, Scooter Braun , and a group of friends. During the trip, the actress practiced water sports, went boating, hiked, and enjoyed a few days outdoors.

The detail that took Sydney Sweeney back to the 90s

Among all the images, there was one that especially caught attention. Sweeney appears in a red one-piece swimsuit with a plunging neckline and high-cut legs, a design that was quickly associated with the aesthetic of ‘Baywatch’.

The resemblance to the swimsuits that Pamela Anderson wore during her time as C.J. Parker was immediate. Red became one of the series’ most recognizable elements and became associated with one of the most memorable television images of the 90s .

“When your man takes you to the moon”, Sweeney wrote alongside the post, accompanying the message with a moon emoji. The photographs were taken during the actress and Braun’s getaway to Lake Powell , in an area surrounded by the rock formations of Glen Canyon.

The comparison with ‘Baywatch’ also comes at a specific moment for the franchise. FOX is preparing a new version of the series, with 12 episodes and a completely renewed cast, although Sweeney is not part of the project.

‘Baywatch’ is coming back, but Sydney Sweeney is not in the cast

The new ‘Baywatch’ will arrive on FOX during the 2026-27 season and is scheduled for January 2027, and will bring back some of the visual elements of the original series, including the iconic red swimsuits.

Prime Video acquired the international rights to the new production for several territories, including Spain and Latin America . The platform will premiere the 12 episodes in those markets in 2027.

For now, Sydney Sweeney 's connection to ‘Baywatch’ is limited to her vacations. The red swimsuit, however, was enough to recall an aesthetic that for years was linked to Pamela Anderson and to the series that turned that image into one of its main symbols.

Sydney Sweeney's other business that multiplied its value

The publication comes after another campaign that put Sweeney at the center of the conversation. The actress became the face of a Novig campaign, a platform specialized in sports prediction markets, but her relationship with the company goes beyond advertising: Sweeney is also a strategic partner and shareholder.

articles.title: Rick Ross arrested on domestic violence charges as attorney denies allegations
articles.standfirst: The rapper faces felony battery by strangulation and misdemeanor battery charges
articles.summary: The rapper faces felony battery by strangulation and misdemeanor battery charges
articles.body:
R ick Ross was arrested in Miami Beach on Thursday, October 1, on two domestic violence-related charges. The 50-year-old rapper, whose legal name is William Leonard Roberts II, was booked into the Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center at 6:10 a.m., according to Miami-Dade records cited by local reporting.

Ross faces one felony count of battery by strangulation and one misdemeanor count of battery. CBS News Miami reports he was released late Thursday morning after a judge set total bond at $5,000.

Rick Ross denies the allegations

His attorney, Steve Sadow, denied the allegations, saying Ross was being wrongfully accused by an ex-girlfriend . Sadow said the police report was filed a month after the alleged incident and that Ross had pleaded not guilty.

He urged the public to allow the judicial process to proceed before judging the case.

The arrest follows public allegations from Ross’s former girlfriend, model and content creator Jazzma Kendrick. On September 26, she shared Instagram Stories showing an apparent lip injury that she attributed to the rapper. “The day Rick busted my lip and the day I left,” she wrote. Her account remains an allegation.

Ross, known for “Hustlin’” and for founding Maybach Music Group, is scheduled for arraignment on October 22. The charges have not been proven in court, and his defense maintains his innocence.

articles.title: Ben Affleck reveals terrifying childhood incident: Held at knifepoint by future killer
articles.standfirst: Affleck opened up about the frightening teenage encounter that took an unexpected turn after he recognized his attackers
articles.summary: Affleck opened up about the frightening teenage encounter that took an unexpected turn after he recognized his attackers
articles.body:
Ben Affleck has opened up about a frightening experience from his teenage years, revealing that he was held at knifepoint during an attempted robbery by someone who would later go on to kill another person.

The actor, now 54, recalled the disturbing encounter during an appearance on Kerry Washington’s Street You Grew Up On podcast.

Affleck said he was around 15 years old and walking home from high school in Cambridge, Massachusetts, when he noticed two older boys on the opposite side of the street.

As the teenagers moved toward him from different directions, Affleck said his instincts immediately kicked in. He considered running but ultimately decided not to, believing he shouldn’t show fear.

The situation quickly became more serious. The boys confronted him, grabbed him and pulled out a knife while demanding his money. Affleck admitted that he was scared, but then recognized the teenagers from playing baseball.

“Out of the corner of my eye, I realized who they were; I recognized them from playing baseball,” he said. “They were older boys that I knew - and they were like, ‘Oh, yeah, what's up?’”

Years later, Affleck learned that one of the teenagers involved had continued down a violent path.

“That kid who robbed me ended up three or four years later killing somebody with a knife and going to prison for 20 years,” said Affleck. “So there was that, you know what I mean? And you were kind of aware of it.”

The memory changed how Affleck viewed his own family

Affleck also explained why he kept the frightening experience from his mother, Chris Anne Affleck , when it happened.

He said he simply didn't want to worry or frighten her, even though she later questioned why he hadn't told her about the incident.

Looking back as a father, Affleck said the experience has influenced the way he communicates with his own children. He makes a point of telling them that they can come to him with anything, reflecting on how reluctant he was to share difficult experiences with his own mother.

The actor's recollections came as he reflected on his childhood following the deaths of both his parents this year. His father, Timothy Affleck , died in April, while his mother died in June at the age of 83.

His mother's death has also prompted Affleck to reconsider the woman he knew primarily as his parent.

He spoke about discovering letters she had written when she was younger, which gave him a new appreciation for her interests and life before motherhood.

"It was so interesting to me because all I knew was a person who just made me and my brother the absolute most important center of her life," he said.

"And it really struck me that she was gorgeous and smart and thoughtful and passionate, and I just thought, 'This woman's amazing. She can do anything.' And there she was, my whole life."

Chris Anne worked as a public-school teacher and devoted herself to raising Affleck and his brother, Casey. Affleck said he now better understands the sacrifices she made for her family.

He also described growing up in a working-class Cambridge neighborhood where poverty, violence and racial tensions were part of everyday life during his youth. Despite those divisions, he remembered friendships often bringing people together.

articles.title: New details emerge in tragic death of Chad Lowe’s 13-year-old daughter, Fiona
articles.standfirst: The latest details come as Fiona’s loved ones remember her as a creative and loving daughter
articles.summary: The latest details come as Fiona’s loved ones remember her as a creative and loving daughter
articles.body:
New details have emerged following the tragic death of Chad Lowe and Kim Painter’s 13-year-old daughter, Fiona Hepler Lowe , who died on Sept. 29.

According to records from the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner reviewed by multiple outlets, Fiona died at a hospital. The case remains open, and officials haven’t publicly disclosed a cause of death or additional circumstances surrounding the tragedy.

The latest information provides a clearer timeline but leaves several questions unanswered as Fiona’s family and community continue to grieve. Representatives for Chad Lowe haven’t publicly commented on the newly released medical examiner information.

The Lowe-Painter family confirmed Fiona’s death in a heartbreaking statement shared with several outlets. They remembered the teenager as “a loving young girl” who was smart, creative and passionate about dancing.

“We are deeply heartbroken by the loss of our beloved Fiona. She was a loving young girl who was smart, creative and loved to dance,” read the statement.

“She was adored by her sisters, and she was deeply loved by her parents. In fact, she was the light of our lives.

“Her passing is devastating for our entire family and we ask for prayers and privacy at this time.”

Chad, 58, and Kim, 52, are also parents to daughters Mabel , 17, and Nixie , 10. Fiona was their middle child. Chad , the younger brother of actor Rob Lowe, had previously shared affectionate tributes to Fiona on social media.

In November 2025, he marked her 13th birthday with a photograph and a loving message encouraging his daughter to “keep dancing through life.” The post offered a glimpse into the close relationship between father and daughter.

Fiona remembered by family, friends and school community

Fiona’s death has also deeply affected the school community where she was a student. Parents reportedly received an email from the school principal informing them that a student had died. The message didn’t identify Fiona by name but expressed condolences to the student’s family, friends and teachers.

School counselors were made available to students and staff who needed emotional support following the news. A source previously described Fiona as a well-liked student who had many friends.

Fiona’s grandfather, Charles “Chuck” Lowe , also remembered his granddaughter publicly. He shared a photograph of her in a swimming pool on Instagram alongside a short tribute.

The family had already endured a major loss in early 2025 when their Pacific Palisades home was destroyed in the devastating wildfire. Weeks later, Chad shared that the family had returned to see what remained of the house where his daughters had grown up.

At the time, he praised his daughters for their resilience and said helping them through the experience was his priority, calling fatherhood his greatest joy and privilege.

Following Fiona’s death, the family included information about the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline in their statement, encouraging anyone struggling with mental health to call or text 988. The family’s reference to the resource doesn’t establish a cause of death, which hasn’t been publicly released.

articles.title: Barack Obama, President of the United States: "As long as there are walls in our hearts, we must strive to tear them down"
articles.standfirst: The 44th President of the United States advocated for a tolerant and egalitarian society
articles.summary: The 44th President of the United States advocated for a tolerant and egalitarian society
articles.body:
' Barack Obama, former President of the United States , has defended throughout his career the need to overcome the barriers that separate people and has championed dialogue as a tool to address social divisions. "As long as there are walls in our hearts, we must strive to tear them down" , is one of the famous quotes of the American politician.'

The statement focuses on the divisions that, beyond physical borders, can arise between communities and citizens . The former president has used the image of walls on numerous occasions as a metaphor for the political, social and cultural differences that, at times, make coexistence difficult.

A message of unity and tolerance on which he based his speech

During his political career, Obama turned the message of unity into one of the cornerstones of his discourse . His 2008 presidential campaign was marked by the idea of overcoming the existing differences in the United States and by a call for citizen participation. Years later, during his time in the White House, he once again defended the need to find common ground in an increasingly polarized society.

The reference to "walls in our hearts" brings that idea into the individual sphere. Faced with physical or institutional barriers, the message points to prejudice, distrust, and a lack of understanding and tolerance among equal people as obstacles that can also hinder understanding.

Barack Obama served as President of the United States between 2009 and 2017 , after becoming in 2008 the first African American president elected to lead the country . His figure has remained linked to initiatives related to civic participation and public debate after leaving the White House. Although with Donald Trump's return, policies and laws that make coexistence more difficult have once again been imposed .

articles.title: A look inside Livvy Dunne's birthday getaway: The ex-LSU star turns heads in blue bikini with Paul Skenes
articles.standfirst: Dunne marked her 24th birthday with Paul Skenes as her post-gymnastics career continues to grow
articles.summary: Dunne marked her 24th birthday with Paul Skenes as her post-gymnastics career continues to grow
articles.body:
O livia Dunne ’s transition from college gymnast to full-fledged media personality continues to accelerate, and her latest birthday post was another reminder of just how large her audience has become.

The former LSU star celebrated turning 24 with a series of photos from the Bahamas, where she is vacationing with boyfriend and Pittsburgh Pirates pitcher Paul Skenes .

One swimsuit image in particular quickly drew attention as fans filled the post with birthday messages. Sports Illustrated Swimsuit editor in chief MJ Day was among those reacting.

“Happiest birthday Livvy,” Day wrote. Another follower added, “What a queen,” while others simply wished Dunne a happy birthday.

Influence far beyond gymnastics

The attention around the post reflects how much Dunne ’s profile has grown since she first emerged as one of the most recognizable athletes in college sports.

Her gymnastics career at LSU provided the platform, but her ability to build a massive social media following turned her into one of the defining names of the NIL era.

Dunne became one of the first college athletes to show how significant name, image and likeness opportunities could become when combined with a large digital audience and strong personal brand.

Day previously described that broader impact when discussing Dunne’s rise.

“Olivia Dunne’s why goes far beyond the floor and bars, it’s about changing the game for athletes everywhere,” Day said.

“She’s not just a social media sensation; she’s a pioneering force who has created opportunities for herself and, by extension, countless other athletes.”

That influence eventually helped carry Dunne onto the cover of Sports Illustrated Swimsuit, further expanding her reach outside gymnastics.

Acting the next major step

Dunne has also made it clear that she wants to keep building beyond sports and social media. Her next major opportunity will come in acting.

She's set to appear in FOX’s upcoming Baywatch reboot, which is scheduled to premiere in January 2027. Dunne will play what has been described as a “highly enthusiastic junior lifeguard.”

That role gives her another chance to move into a different part of the entertainment industry after years of growing her profile through athletics, modeling and brand partnerships.

Her 24th birthday therefore arrives at an interesting point in her career. Dunne is no longer simply the former LSU gymnast who became one of the biggest names in NIL.

She's entering a stage where acting, media and business opportunities are becoming just as central to her public identity. The Bahamas photos were a celebratory moment.

They also underscored something that has become increasingly clear: even after leaving college gymnastics behind, Dunne has no trouble remaining firmly in the spotlight.

articles.title: Bruce Lee, martial artist and actor: "The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus"
articles.standfirst: The martial arts legend believed ordinary people could achieve extraordinary results by concentrating their effort with discipline
articles.summary: The martial arts legend believed ordinary people could achieve extraordinary results by concentrating their effort with discipline
articles.body:
B ruce Lee ’s image is inseparable from precision. Every movement looked deliberate, every strike economical, every performance built around control.

That same philosophy sits behind one of the quotes most associated with him: “The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.”

The line strips away the mythology around achievement. Lee ’s point wasn't that talent is irrelevant, but that talent without direction can easily be wasted.

Focus, in his view, is what turns potential into progress. That's important because it makes the message accessible.

Success isn't reserved for people who start with exceptional advantages; it can come from someone ordinary who learns how to direct effort consistently.

That way of thinking shaped his approach to martial arts. Lee rejected the idea that one rigid system should dictate how a fighter moved or responded.

articles.title: Ernest Hemingway, American novelist: "If something is wrong, fix it if you can. But train yourself not to worry. Worry never fixes anything"
articles.standfirst: The American novelist’s message draws a sharp line between taking action and wasting energy on what cannot be controlled
articles.summary: The American novelist’s message draws a sharp line between taking action and wasting energy on what cannot be controlled
articles.body:
Some problems need fixing. Others cannot be fixed immediately, no matter how long someone thinks about them.

That tension sits at the center of a quote widely attributed to Ernest Hemingway : “If something is wrong, fix it if you can. But train yourself not to worry. Worry never fixes anything.”

The line is striking because it doesn't dismiss concern or suggest that people should simply ignore difficult circumstances. Hemingway ’s advice begins with responsibility and to identify what is wrong and take action when action is available.

Only then comes the more demanding part. Once every practical step has been taken, continuing to replay the problem doesn't create another solution. It can feel like preparation, but worry often becomes an endless rehearsal of outcomes that may never happen.

Hemingway message is about action

The distinction between concern and worry matters. Concern can prompt someone to prepare for an examination, deal with a financial problem, have an uncomfortable conversation or work harder before an important competition. In each case, the emotion leads toward something concrete.

Worry becomes different when there is nothing useful left to do. That helps explain the phrase “train yourself.” Letting go of unnecessary worry rarely happens automatically. It can take practice to recognize when careful thinking has crossed into repeatedly imagining the same problem without changing anything.

The lesson isn't to stop caring about consequences. It's to ask a more useful question of what can I actually do next? If there is an answer, act on it. If there is not, worrying harder will not manufacture one.

Why the quote still connects with modern life

The principle feels particularly relevant in a world where people can spend almost unlimited time monitoring problems, comparing themselves with others and anticipating what might happen next.

Athletes can prepare for competition but cannot control every bounce, call or opponent. Professionals can make strong decisions without knowing how every colleague or customer will respond.

Students can study thoroughly without controlling exactly what appears on a test. There is effort on one side and uncertainty on the other. Hemingway’s quote offers a way to separate them.

His writing repeatedly returned to people confronting pressure, loss, uncertainty and circumstances beyond their control. Whatever the setting, the question was often less about whether hardship existed and more about how someone chose to meet it.

That is why the final sentence carries so much weight: “Worry never fixes anything.” It's not a promise that everything will work out. It's a reminder that anxiety and action are not the same thing.

Fix what is within reach. Prepare as well as possible. Make the decision that needs to be made. Then recognize when there is nothing more to solve.

articles.title: Ken Urker, Cause of Death: Gypsy Rose Blanchard's ex-boyfriend dies at just 34
articles.standfirst: Urker was found dead on October 1.
articles.summary: Urker was found dead on October 1.
articles.body:
K en Urke r, the former fiancé of Gypsy Rose Blanchard and father of her daughter, has died suddenly at 34, with the circumstances surrounding his death still unclear as news of his death emerged on October 1 . Ken was reportedly found unresponsive inside a Louisiana home on his birthday on Thursday, and according to reports, Gypsy had sent a birthday message but became concerned after receiving no response.

Her brother, Dylan , and his wife reportedly went to check on him and discovered him unresponsive and no official cause of death has been publicly confirmed as of Friday, October 2. Gypsy later spoke about the loss, describing herself as devastated and saying she could not think clearly after learning what had happened and hinted he was facing struggles with his mental health. “I’m in disbelief. I can’t think. I’ve screamed until my throat burns,” Gypsy told PEOPLE. “I don’t know if it was intentional or not. He was not in a good state of mind lately. “Ken was an amazing father and a man who was deeply loved. He will forever be my soulmate and my red string, a connection that time, distance, and even death can never erase. Above all, Ken loved our daughter, Aurora. "She is a beautiful reflection of his enduring spirit, and through her, a part of him will always remain with us. I will make sure she grows up knowing how deeply her father loved her and who he was beyond what strangers on the internet chose to say about him.”

Gypsy Rose Blanchard and Ken Urker's relationship

Ken first contacted Gypsy in 2017 while she was serving her prison sentence for her role in the death of her mother, Claudine “Dee Dee” Blanchard . After watching the HBO documentary Mommy Dead and Dearest , he sent her a letter of support. Their correspondence developed into a relationship, and Ken proposed in October 2018, but the couple later separated in 2019 as Gypsy eventually married Ryan Scott Anderson in a jailhouse ceremony in 2022. After Gypsy was released from prison in December 2023, her marriage to Ryan ended in March 2024. She soon reconnected with Ken , with the pair publicly spending time together again the following month and even getting matching tattoos. Gypsy confirmed their relationship had been rekindled in April 2024. Ken subsequently relocated to New Orleans to be closer to his fiancée and her family, as she remained in Louisiana under the conditions of her parole. The couple announced they were expecting their first child together in July 2024 and their daughter, Aurora Raina Urker , was born December 28, 2024, marking another major chapter in their relationship. Ken and Gypsy later became less visible together online, and reports surrounding his death have referred to him as her “ex-fiancé,” suggesting they had separated before his death. The circumstances of Ken 's death remain under investigation, and an official cause has not been disclosed publicly. He leaves behind his daughter, Aurora , and a family mourning his sudden passing at the age of 34.

articles.title: The mystery of the $2 Million mansion: An inside look at the strange death of Flora Cafaro and her secret connection to Jeffrey Epstein
articles.standfirst: Cafaro’s death continues to attract suspicion a decade later.
articles.summary: Cafaro’s death continues to attract suspicion a decade later.
articles.body:
The mystery surrounding a $2 million mansion has resurfaced years after the death of financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein , with newly examined documents drawing attention to the previously little-known case of Ohio businesswoman Flora Cafaro . Cafaro , a 58-year-old philanthropist from the Youngstown area, died in 2016 after firefighters found her unconscious in an upstairs bathroom of her home, after suffering smoke inhalation and burns to her face and upper body.

She was taken to a nearby hospital, where she was pronounced dead and the circumstances of the fire have continued to raise questions as fire marshals ultimately closed their investigation without determining how the blaze began. The marshals ruled the cause of the fire as undetermined, which received a questionable response as investigators reportedly recovered a lighter and a butane cylinder near the scene, while Cafaro was not known to smoke. Her son, William Cafaro-Ferraro , also told investigators that his mother had limited use of one hand following a car accident, raising questions about whether she could have operated the lighter at all.

How Flora Cafaro became connected to Jeffrey Epstein

The connection to Epstein emerged years later through documents contained in a massive release of files associated with his activities and contacts and among them was a 2011 email exchange involving the pedophile and his longtime attorney, Martin G. Weinberg . Flora had herself become involved in an legal controversy in 2010 after providing an $18,000 interest-free loan to a former county judge who was later sentenced to 27 months in federal prison for mail fraud. Members of the wider Cafaro family were also named that year in a 73-count corruption indictment involving allegations including bribery and money laundering. Those charges were ultimately dropped and Weinberg wrote in an email titled ‘ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGE’: “Will know tomorrow whether the case in Ohio will end before Wednesday. Very possibly will end with a win Monday.” Epstein responded, “Great.” Weinberg followed the next day with: “Case dismissed. State v Cafaro.” The exchange does not establish that Epstein had any involvement in Cafaro 's death but it instead documents his interest in a legal matter involving her family and provides a previously obscure link between the pair. Epstein 's broader history explains why Cafaro ’s connection and those of his other associates attract scrutiny, as he pleaded guilty in 2008 to state charges involving prostitution and a minor and was registered as a sex offender. Federal prosecutors had charged him with sex trafficking minors, but he died in custody in New York City on April 10 before the case reached trial - officially ruled a suicide by hanging. A 2023 Department of Justice inspector general investigation criticized serious failures by jail personnel but found no evidence contradicting the suicide ruling, although conspiracies continue to circulate that he was silenced.

articles.title: Megan Fox in a sexy red catsuit ‘becomes the drug’ to lift more than men’s spirits even when they feel embarrassed
articles.standfirst: The actress brings humor and sex appeal to a campaign aimed at easing the shame around erectile dysfunction
articles.summary: The actress brings humor and sex appeal to a campaign aimed at easing the shame around erectile dysfunction
articles.body:
Megan Fox made it clear, without holding back, in a recent interview: she feels she was born for this. At this point in her life, she is comfortable discussing intimacy and understands the pressure men can feel when it comes to enjoying sex .

The 40-year-old actress stars in a campaign for an erectile dysfunction treatment, addressing something that can leave many men feeling embarrassed and frustrated. With humor, she presents an option intended to help them regain confidence in the bedroom.

Megan Fox invites men to stop suffering in silence

When a man experiences erectile dysfunction, it can leave him feeling low. But Megan has taken on a role promoting a medical option designed to lift much more than his spirits.

Dressed in a sensual, skintight red catsuit, she plays the medication itself. That is the campaign’s central idea: the treatment, brought to life by the actress, speaks directly to viewers and invites them to address an issue they may have been keeping to themselves.

Her approach is to bring some humor to a conversation that already carries enough pressure. Rather than making the subject feel even heavier, she wants the campaign to make it easier for men and their partners to talk about intimacy.

Ro Sparks is a prescription treatment containing sildenafil, the active ingredient in Viagra, and tadalafil, the active ingredient in Cialis. According to Ro, it dissolves under the tongue rather than being swallowed. The company also states that Sparks is a compounded medication and is not FDA-approved.

The ad delivers its message through playful lines and deliberate double meanings. “If prescribed, I show up right at your door. Don’t worry, my packaging is very discreet,” Fox says, staying in character as the treatment.

Behind the suggestive delivery is a more empathetic message. Fox told People that she hopes the humor helps remove some of the embarrassment around erectile dysfunction, encouraging men to recognize that it is something they can discuss openly.

The campaign was even bolder than she expected. Fox initially thought she and her team would have to ask the creators for more humor, more sex appeal and more fun. Instead, they ended up asking them to tone down some of the jokes and innuendo.

The red catsuit gets the attention. The humor keeps the conversation going. And Fox’s message gives the campaign its purpose: men should be able to talk about what happens in the bedroom without feeling ashamed.

articles.title: Ester Expósito conquers Paris in a spectacular Roberto Cavalli silk dress worth 2,500 euros
articles.standfirst: The actress attended the Messika show in a black Roberto Cavalli design that she paired with diamond jewelry from the French brand.
articles.summary: The actress attended the Messika show in a black Roberto Cavalli design that she paired with diamond jewelry from the French brand.
articles.body:
E ster Expósito has once again become one of the standout faces of Paris Fashion Week. The actress attended the Messika show in a spectacular black Roberto Cavalli dress that left much of her back exposed and stands out for its combination of silk, sheer fabrics, and ruffles. The design, which is part of the Italian brand's fall-winter 2026/27 collection, is priced at 2,500 euros.

The actress opted for a look in which the dress drew practically all the attention. It is a long silk piece with a plunging V-neckline, very thin straps, and dropped sleeves that leave the shoulders bare. The fluid silhouette adds movement to the outfit, while the different ruffles run along part of the skirt.

Esther Expósito: A completely bare back

But the most striking detail appears when she turns around. The back of the dress is left almost completely open, with the fabric falling from the straps and leaving her back exposed. The sheer quality of the material also adds a lingerie-like effect to the outfit without the need to incorporate any other elements.

To complete the styling, Expósito turned to v arious pieces of jewelry by Messika . A diamond necklace and earrings added a touch of sparkle over the black dress and reinforced the sophisticated character of her appearance at the show.

The actress also chose to wear her hair pulled back into a low ponytail, leaving a few loose strands around her face. The natural, radiant makeup kept the focus on the dress and the jewelry.

Her appearance at the Messika show once again places her among the guests who have attracted the most attention during these fashion days in Paris . A choice that combines one of the most present trends in eveningwear proposals, such as sheer fabrics, with the classic design of a black dress and the Roberto Cavalli signature.

articles.title: Emma Heming, Bruce Willis's wife, on the actor's illness: "I will not let his diagnosis be in vain"'
articles.standfirst: The actor has had Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) since 2023
articles.summary: The actor has had Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) since 2023
articles.body:
"E mma Heming , Bruce Willis 's wife, has shared a moving new photograph of the actor on her Instagram profile, coinciding with World Frontotemporal Dementia Awareness Week (FTD) , the neurodegenerative disease suffered by the Hollywood star.

Accompanying the image, in which Willis can be seen wearing comfortable clothes, a hat, and sunglasses , Heming has dedicated some heartfelt words intended to shed light on the reality of caregivers and families going through this same process. In her message, she highlights that the actor "would be proud to know that he is helping other families" and reaffirms her firm commitment to the cause: "I will not allow his diagnosis to be in vain".

Emma Heming, Bruce Willis's wife: “Bruce continues to build his legacy”

The aim of the publication is to use the family’s media platform during World FTD Week so that other caregivers and affected households feel heard and supported in their respective journeys. “I can’t go through World Frontotemporal Dementia Awareness Week without talking about Bruce. He is the driving force behind my advocacy work,” begins the text written by Bruce Willis’s wife.

"In this new stage of his life, Bruce continues building his legacy. He is, and always will be, a fucking legend. And I am very proud to be his wife," she adds. Following his diagnosis, the family has focused its efforts on providing him with the greatest possible comfort, having previously moved to a single-story adapted home with full-time medical assistance.

As part of her awareness-raising and support work, Emma Heming Willis is the author of the book ‘The Unexpected Journey: Finding Strength, Hope, and Yourself on the Caregiving Path’ , a guide focused on the mental health and well-being of those who care for dependent people.

articles.standfirst: They fell in love in 1984 during the filming of the hit movie "Romancing the stone’
articles.summary: They fell in love in 1984 during the filming of the hit movie "Romancing the stone’
articles.body:
American actor Michael Douglas revealed in his new memoir that he had a romantic relationship with Kathleen Turner, his co-star in ‘Romancing the Stone,’ and confessed that they decided to keep the romance secret for four decades, according to People.

articles.title: Messages from Halle Berry to her ex-husband Olivier Martinez have come to light, putting her in an even more delicate situation with her son
articles.standfirst: Newly surfaced texts offer a glimpse into the tense relationship between Berry and her son
articles.summary: Newly surfaced texts offer a glimpse into the tense relationship between Berry and her son
articles.body:
Messages exchanged between Halle Berry and her former husband Olivier Martinez have shed new light on the increasingly tense custody dispute involving their 12-year-old son, Maceo.

The conversations were included in court documents after Martinez sought a temporary restraining order and asked for sole custody of their son.

In his filing, the actor alleged that Berry physically assaulted Maceo during an incident on Sept. 26, claiming she jumped on him, put her hands around his neck and choked him. The allegations haven't been established in court, and Berry's representatives have strongly disputed Martinez's account.

The text messages nevertheless show the strained relationship between Berry and her son around the time of the alleged incident.

According to the documents, Martinez told Berry that Maceo had asked to be picked up early. Berry reportedly reacted angrily, questioning why her son wanted to leave and expressing frustration over what she described as his lack of respect for her.

In subsequent messages, Berry allegedly told Martinez that Maceo believed she had little authority over him.

“I’m his mother and this is wrong! He had no respect for his mother and this should not be ok for you as his father!!!,” wrote Berry .

“He is disrespectful to me and feels I have no say on anything thing. I’m just money bags! This is wrong and wrong!”

The exchange reportedly took a different tone the following day, when Berry contacted Martinez again. She said she'd reached out to Maceo and asked her former husband to encourage their son to speak with her.

Berry also acknowledged that she felt terrible about what had happened the previous night and said she believed Maceo felt the same way.

The custody dispute enters a new legal phase

Both parents' legal teams have presented very different accounts of the situation. Martinez's attorney, Patrick Baghdaserians , said his client's main concern is Maceo's health, welfare and safety, describing Martinez as a parent who has tried to do what's best for his son.

Berry's attorney, Marina Beck , has called Martinez's filing “entirely meritless and deliberately misleading.” She has also accused Martinez of previously violating court orders and interfering with therapeutic and educational interventions involving Maceo .

Those claims are also disputed and form part of the broader conflict between the former couple.

A Los Angeles County judge granted Martinez a temporary restraining order on Oct. 1. Under the order, Berry must remain 100 yards away from Martinez , although the court didn't completely prevent her from seeing their son. Her visitation with Maceo is subject to temporary restrictions, while a further hearing is scheduled for Oct. 16.

Berry and Martinez married in 2013 and separated several years later, eventually finalizing their divorce in 2023. Their agreement provided for joint legal custody of Maceo , along with financial arrangements that included child support and other expenses.

articles.title: Moving on after Jennifer Lopez? Ben Affleck breaks his silence on his love life two years after the divorce
articles.standfirst: The actor opens up about life after Jennifer Lopez and addresses Shakira dating rumors
articles.summary: The actor opens up about life after Jennifer Lopez and addresses Shakira dating rumors
articles.body:
Ben Affleck has offered a rare update on his romantic life, making it clear that finding a new relationship isn't currently high on his list of priorities.

The 54-year-old actor and filmmaker opened up about dating while promoting his new thriller Animals. Speaking with Entertainment Tonight at the film's premiere, Affleck explained that much of his attention is already devoted to his career and his three children, whom he shares with ex-wife Jennifer Garner.

“There’s not a lot of room. I’m not running around,” Affleck said when asked about dating. “It’s just not a big priority in my life.

“I know what my priorities are. You can’t have two things that are the most important in your life. For me, that’s the kids. So that’s what that is. And then I have my work, which I love.”

While he isn't actively searching for a partner, Affleck hasn't completely closed the door on romance. He indicated that he's open to whatever life might bring in the future, but he's not interested in chasing a relationship simply for the sake of being in one.

“I’m where I’m at, and I’m great, and who knows what adventures life will bring. I’m open to it, but I’m not trying to chase anything,” he added.

His comments come as renewed attention surrounds his personal life, particularly following his highly publicized marriage to Jennifer Lopez and their subsequent divorce.

Ben Affleck addresses the Shakira matchmaking story

During the same interview, Affleck was asked about a surprising claim made by The View co-host Ana Navarro. Navarro r ecently said she'd considered playing matchmaker between Affleck and Shakira after both stars had become single.

According to Navarro , she was attending a Shakira concert in Miami when she spoke with Affleck's longtime friend Matt Damon.

At the time, Affleck and Lopez were reportedly heading toward a split, while Shakira had also ended her relationship with Gerard Piqué. Navarro suggested that Affleck and Shakira might eventually consider contacting one another.

Affleck , however, appeared genuinely unaware of the alleged matchmaking attempt. He said he'd never heard the story before and suggested that rumors about his personal life often reach him through the media rather than directly.

“I hear s*** like that, honestly, first from people like you,” Affleck said. “I never heard that in my whole life. People gossip. Stuff gets made up.”

Affleck and Lopez rekindled their romance in 2021 after initially becoming engaged in the early 2000s. They married in 2022, but their relationship ended less than two years later, with their divorce finalized in January 2025.

Before Lopez, Affleck was married to Garner from 2005 until their divorce was finalized in 2018. The former couple share Violet, Seraphina and Samuel.

However, for the time being at least, Affleck appears content to keep romance in the background while concentrating on his children and career.

articles.standfirst: Raun has over 15 million followers on TikTok, but she earns over 40 million on OnlyFans
articles.summary: Raun has over 15 million followers on TikTok, but she earns over 40 million on OnlyFans
articles.body:
It is certainly no secret that top-tier creators on platforms like OnlyFans generate staggering amounts of wealth. Consider Sophie Rain , the 22-year-old creator who raked in over $40 million in her first breakout year back in 2024.

To put that sum into perspective, her annual earnings outpace more than half of the starting NFL quarterbacks this season , and rival the lucrative contracts of elite NBA All-Stars like OG Anunoby or Kevin Durant.

While some critics routinely decry the changing economic landscape of digital entrepreneurship, the reality remains simple: as long as there is consumer demand, new avenues of wealth creation will continue to thrive.

Not everyone is willing to embrace this modern reality, however, notably actor and comedian Pete Davidson , who recently launched into a public rant mocking social media influencers who "do nothing" and pull in $40 million a year. Those pointed remarks quickly made their way to Rain, who delivered a sharp and unfiltered response.

Sophie Rain Fires Back at Pete Davidson's Critique

OnlyFans star Sophie Rain recently challenged Pete Davidson to put his money where his mouth is after the actor went viral for ridiculing creators who make millions while doing "nothing" for their cash. Rain commented with “@me next time” on the Instagram clip of the diss, which came from Davidson’s interview with Variety.

Rain, who pulls in an estimated $45 million annually , did not take the jab lying down. "I’d tell him that if it’s really that easy, he should go do it," Rain stated in an interview with The Post .

Noting that Davidson has previously joked about launching an OnlyFans account himself, she added that anyone who believes individuals make millions by pure accident clearly lacks a fundamental understanding of digital business.

The internet entrepreneur pointed out that Davidson's rant felt deliberately targeted at her and other successful women on the platform, calling it cowardly for the comedian to generalize without naming names directly.

Rain, who is known on the site for limiting her content to suggestive lingerie and bikini-level teasing rather than explicit adult material, defended the rigorous hustle behind her brand. "I don’t think saying women are doing 'nothing' because you don’t understand their jobs is particularly clever. There are definitely better jokes," she remarked.
